newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 2c to 623c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 2c to 623c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose two cents to 623 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at sales in Newcastle and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was mixed, with 19/20/26 microns one percent dearer and 21m 1.5 percent dearer but 22/23/24m one percent cheaper and 25m 0.5 percent cheaper.
Merino skirtings of 19/20m were up to one percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 27/28m were 0.5 percent dearer, 29m slightly cheaper and 30/31m unchanged, it said.
In cardings, lambs and crutchings were unchanged, with locks slightly dearer.
WI said Japanese interests, including China, were the principal buyers, with support from local mills and Western Europe.
Of the 23,549 bales offered, 3.5 percent were passed in.
Sales continue Wednesday in Newcastle, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 35,300 bales to be offered.
